intro: Deep beneath the dusty ghost town of Moonbrook, the Deadmines are a sprawling underground labyrinth that once produced a third of Stormwind's gold reserves. Abandoned during the First War and long whispered to be haunted, the forgotten shafts have become the fortified headquarters of Edwin VanCleef and his rebellious Defias Brotherhood.

sections.t: A Vein of Gold and Blood
p: Before the First War, the Deadmines were the premier mining operation in human lands, rich in gold and sturdy Whitestone oak used for timber and structural supports. When the orcish Horde pushed north, the mines were abandoned in haste. Sir Anduin Lothar notably ventured into their treacherous depths to recover the sacred Tome of Divinity, surviving twenty months of captivity at the hands of subterranean ogres before being rescued. In the turmoil that followed the kingdom's fall, the shafts fell silent and gained a chilling reputation for being cursed.
